I added a log line to `refund()` in `src/billing/refunds.py` that records the invoice id. It runs after the amount check passes, so a refund that gets rejected isn't logged:

```python
log.info("invoice_refunded", invoice_id=invoice.id, refunded_cents=amount_cents)
```

It uses `structlog` with a module-level `log = structlog.get_logger()`, the same way `src/billing/invoices.py` logs. A project memory says to use `structlog`, not Python's standard `logging`.

I also included `refunded_cents`, which you didn't ask for. It's easy to drop if you only want the invoice id. I haven't run anything to check the change.
